Definition: Jirmejah, the name of eight or nine Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jeremiah = "whom Jehovah has appointed"; 1) the major prophet, son of Hilkiah of the priestly family in Anathoth; author of the prophetic book bearing his name; 2) a man of Libnah and father of Hamutal the wife of king Josiah; 3) a Gadite who joined David at Ziklag; 4) a Manassehite, one of the mighty men of valour of the Transjordanic half tribe of Manasseh; 5) a Gadite and warrior of David; 6) a warrior of David; 7) a priest who joined Nehemiah in the covenant ceremony; 8) a priest also in the time of Nehemiah; maybe same as 7; 9) father of Jaazaniah the Rechabites
